library.title: Assess housing eligibility
library.intro: The officer records, criterion by criterion of the programme's terms in force, whether each is met and on what evidence, and the priority factors found. Eligibility and points follow from the terms; an application found ineligible is decided by an official who can sign, with reasons.
library.filled_by: An officer of the housing authority.
library.authority: Filed with the housing authority the nation names for its housing slot (shipped empty).

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

The competent body is the institution the nation names for its slot of the deployment profile (landRegistry, buildingControl, housing, vehicleRegistration, roadAuthority, transportRegulator), shipped empty; who holds each power over a decision comes from the permit authority registry, proposed and unapproved
deviations.why: Authority comes from the deployment profile and the approved mappings, never a ministry by name; a production installation refuses a power no approved mapping covers.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(); lib/permits/decisions.ts (plan I7)

deviations.what: Eligibility criteria and priority factors with their points are the programme's terms, approved by two officials citing the law, each version kept with its digest; an officer records each criterion met or not with its evidence, and eligibility and points follow from the terms in force
deviations.why: Housing allocation uses transparent, approved eligibility and priority rules; none ship.

deviations.what: Accessibility needs are what the home must have, never a medical detail; income and household evidence stay documents of the case
deviations.why: No patient or clinical field anywhere (CLAUDE.md Health).
deviations.rule: lib/forms/scope.ts; lib/housing/register.ts (no income figures or health details kept)

deviations.what: Every registration and decision is proposed by one official and confirmed by a different person; the official who verified or reviewed does not decide
deviations.why: Catalogue Part 8 §3.3 and Part 9 §5: dual control by distinct authorised individuals.

deviations.what: No step is decided by a model, a score or a map: officials decide with reasons
deviations.why: AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model (AI never makes a legally material decision)
